title: YorvoGate readiness, format 1
description: The admin listener's GET /readyz answer (docs/configuration.md#monitoring): 200 when ready, 503 when not. For routing and alerts, never for restarts (/healthz is the process's). Open for additions at every level (ADR-0005, amendment 1): a later release may add checks.

config_sha256.description: The SHA-256 of the configuration file in effect: an edit took when it's the edited file's.

draining.description: true while the process stops: not ready, whatever the checks say.

checks.description: Each check, ok or why not: docker, defaults, api_versions, scopes, spool (an open set).
